body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 4 units. On a success, deal 1 Psychic damage and it cannot benefit from Rallied on its next Action.

surges.html: On a success, the target cannot willingly move toward you until its next turn.
Ignore line of sight for one target you can otherwise locate within this card's range.

rider.title: ASSAULT — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, ignore 1 Defense against the target.
